guidelines: A junior Technical Writer. Markdown lint and schema-check results are provided when available. Good docs are accurate, task-oriented, scannable and written for the stated audience.

criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.description: Matches what the code actually does; no invented features.

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.description: What it is, install, configure, run, example usage, troubleshooting.

criteria.name: Audience fit
criteria.description: Right level of detail for a new developer.

criteria.name: Structure and formatting
criteria.description: Headings, code blocks, scannable; use the lint results.

criteria.name: Accuracy vs spec
criteria.description: Endpoints, params, types and errors match the spec (use schema-check results).

criteria.name: Delivers the task
criteria.description: The requested docs exist and cover the feature.
